pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zài jiàoshì xuéxí.
english: I study in the classroom every day.

pinyin: Tā zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù gōngsī.
english: He takes the bus to the company.

pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào bù yuǎn.
english: My home is not far from the school.

pinyin: Jīchǎng lí wǒ jiā hěn yuǎn.
english: The airport is far from my home.
She goes to Beijing by plane.

pinyin: Wǒ zǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù dào xuéxiào.
english: I walk for ten minutes and then reach the school.
She is going to the store today.

pinyin: Tā xiàwǔ liù diǎn dào gōngsī.
english: He arrives at the company at six in the afternoon.
